description: A React component implementing a slide-out drawer for adding nodes, with search, categorization, and drag-and-drop functionality.

classes.name: AddNodesDrawerProps
classes.description: Props interface for AddNodesDrawer component, including nodes array and optional callbacks.

classes.name: AddNodesDrawerComponent
classes.description: Main React functional component for the Add Nodes Drawer UI.

methods.name: AddNodesDrawerComponent
methods.description: Handles rendering and logic for the node addition drawer, including search, categorization, and drag-and-drop.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Renders the icon for a node based on its name.

methods.name: groupNodes
methods.description: Groups nodes by category and manages expansion state.

methods.name: handleSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search value and triggers debounced search.

methods.name: handleClearSearch
methods.description: Clears search input and resets node grouping.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the open state of the drawer.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the drawer when clicking outside.

methods.name: handleAccordionChange
methods.description: Expands or collapses a category accordion.
